Conference records
derived

Weekly leaders
verified

Previous available week; future selected weeks explicitly retain latest verified leader week.
Current roster
verified
Current retained roster: active, reserve and practice squad; cut players excluded.
Player statistics
derived

Team statistics
derived

Schedule & results
verified
Kickoff converted from America/New_York with daylight saving. Fixture records are entering each week; future records reflect latest completed week, not predictions.
Injury & practice reports
unavailable

Depth chart
verified

derived

verified

derived

unavailable

travel

cross Checks
partial

roster Verification
partial

Missing optional sources retain prior flags only for the identical primary roster hash. No primary or historical fields are overwritten.

derived
